title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 4: B1 FLUENCY & REAL-WORLD ENGLISH

targets.active_vocabulary: 1200+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs and functional expressions
targets.skills: integrated vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, conversation, writing and real-life communication

grammar_focus: present, past and future tense contrast
present perfect and present perfect continuous
future forms: will, going to, present continuous
modals for obligation, advice, possibility and deduction
linking words, discourse markers and paragraph cohesion
register: informal, neutral and formal English

missions.title: B1 Vocabulary Precision Lab
missions.focus: word families, collocations, phrasal verbs, synonyms and context
missions.output: Use 35–45 target items in original sentences and a short dialogue

missions.title: Tense Control Center
missions.focus: present, past and future forms with meaning and time relationships
missions.output: Explain choices and produce a connected timeline story

missions.title: Perfect Forms Mission
missions.focus: present perfect, present perfect continuous and past perfect
missions.output: Interview a partner about experiences, duration and earlier events

missions.title: Storytelling with Narrative Tenses
missions.focus: past simple, past continuous and past perfect
missions.output: Retell a 500-word event with clear sequencing and detail

missions.title: Future Plans & Predictions
missions.focus: will, going to, present continuous and probability language
missions.output: Discuss plans, predictions and alternative outcomes

missions.title: Modal Meaning Lab
missions.focus: must, have to, should, might, may, could and deduction
missions.output: Solve situations using advice, rules, probability and evidence

missions.title: Conditionals in Real Life
missions.focus: zero, first and second conditionals
missions.output: Discuss consequences, hypothetical choices and practical problems

missions.title: Complex Sentence Builder
missions.focus: relative clauses, conjunctions and information density
missions.output: Combine short ideas into accurate B1 paragraphs

missions.title: Passive & Reported Information
missions.focus: passive voice and introductory reported speech
missions.output: Transform news, instructions and messages while preserving meaning

missions.title: B1 Fluency Conversation Lab
missions.focus: questions, follow-ups, clarification, turn-taking and natural fillers
missions.output: Hold a 10–12 minute conversation without scripted answers

missions.title: Reading Mastery — The Unexpected Opportunity
missions.focus: main ideas, details, inference, reference words and vocabulary in context
missions.output: Read 900–1050 words and defend comprehension answers with evidence

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Voices in the Real World
missions.focus: natural speed, connected speech, different speakers and implied meaning
missions.output: Complete detail, inference and speaker-intention tasks from 9–11 minutes

missions.title: Writing Lab — A Strong B1 Argument
missions.focus: topic sentences, supporting reasons, examples, contrast and conclusion
missions.output: Write 260–320 words presenting a clear position with reasons

missions.title: Story & Experience Writing
missions.focus: description, sequencing, narrative detail and emotional vocabulary
missions.output: Write a complete personal or fictional story with a clear turning point

missions.title: Travel Command Center
missions.focus: booking, delays, changes, directions, accommodation and polite requests
missions.output: Complete a multi-stage travel role-play and recover from unexpected problems

missions.title: Health, Safety & Public Services
missions.focus: symptoms, appointments, emergencies, instructions and formal requests
missions.output: Handle realistic doctor, pharmacy, emergency and public-service dialogues

missions.title: Work, Study & Digital Communication
missions.focus: emails, meetings, deadlines, applications, online communication and tone
missions.output: Write messages and participate in a simulated school/work meeting

missions.title: Problem-Solving Simulation — Five Problems
missions.focus: clarification, negotiation, alternatives, compromise and decision-making
missions.output: Solve five connected real-world problems while explaining each decision

missions.title: B1 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing under time pressure
missions.output: Complete a full B1 communication circuit with accuracy and fluency targets

missions.title: WORLD 4 MASTER QUEST — B1 FLUENCY
missions.focus: final integrated B1 mission
missions.output: Complete reading, natural listening, extended conversation, writing, presentation and real-life simulation

assessment.production: clear connected speech and organized writing
